summary: An icon on the compass and map. On the server, a blip shows to chosen players wherever they are. In a client script, it appears only on that player's compass and map, and neither the server nor other players know about it. A blip ends with the resource that made it.

image.summary: A .dds picture your resource ships, used as this blip's icon, or '' for its type's icon.
image.example: console.info(blip.image || 'uses the icon of its type');
image.exampleLua: print(blip.image or "uses the icon of its type")
image.exampleCs: Log.Info((string.IsNullOrEmpty(blip.Image) ? "uses the icon of its type" : blip.Image));

params.options: `position`, required; `type`, a name from Blip.types(), default 'GeneralPoi'; `markState`; `label`, up to 64 bytes; `compass` and `map`, both true by default; `image`, a .dds your resource ships. On a client, also `legend`, true by default, whether the map legend's switch for its type hides it. On the server, also `dimension`, and `player`, a player or list of players who see it, by default everyone.

create.exampleLua: local smithyBlip = kcds.world.Blip.create({ position = kcds.math.Vector3.new(100, 200, 10), type = "Shop", label = "Blacksmith" })
create.exampleCs: var smithyBlip = Blip.Create(new { position = new Vector3(100, 200, 10), type = "Shop", label = "Blacksmith" });

all.summary: All blips, or on the server, those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

getById.summary: The blip with this id, or null.

removeAll.summary: Removes all blips, or on the server, optionally those in one dimension.

params.dimension: Optional: limits it to this dimension.

types.summary: Icon names a blip can use, such as 'Shop', 'Home', 'Pub', 'Camp' and 'FastTravel'.

exists.exampleLua:
if not blip.exists then
  print("removed")
end

type.summary: The icon type. You can assign to it.

markState.summary: The game's mark state of the icon, a whole number, 0 when created. You can assign to it, and anything else throws a TypeError.

label.summary: The text with the icon, up to 64 bytes. You can assign to it.

compass.summary: Whether the icon shows on the compass. You can assign to it.

legend.summary: Client only. Whether this blip follows the map legend's switch for its icon type, as game marks do. True by default. With false, it stays visible when that type is off, so you can hide the game's marks with WorldMap.setMapCategory and show yours with the same icon. Server blips always follow the switch. You can assign to it, and a non-boolean throws a TypeError.
legend.exampleLua:
-- client
local WorldMap, Blip = kcds.world.WorldMap, kcds.world.Blip

WorldMap.setMapCategory("Shop", false)
Blip.create({ position = kcds.math.Vector3.new(1652.5, 2151.5, 37), type = "Shop", label = "Our stall", legend = false })

map.summary: Whether the icon shows on the map. You can assign to it.

position.summary: The location it marks. You can assign to it.

dimension.summary: Its dimension. Change it with setDimension.

setDimension.summary: Moves the blip to another dimension.

destroy.summary: Removes the blip, the same as remove.

valid.summary: False once this client blip is removed.
valid.exampleLua:
-- client
if not blip.valid then
  print("removed")
end

live.summary: Whether the compass currently has the mark.

state.summary: Client blips only, deprecated since 0.3.4. The old name of markState, which hid an entity's SharedState. It will be removed in a later release, and is left out of the TypeScript declarations.

showOnlyTo.summary: Limits who sees it. null shows it to everyone again.
